issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

saveOpenIteratorsStackTrace.description: True if we should save the stack trace when tracking open iterators.

hideSqlErrors.description: True if sql should be suppressed from any errors thrown by the database

statsLoggingFrequencySeconds.description: Frequency to log various database/query statistics.

monitorLoopFrequencySeconds.description: Frequency to run the monitor loop.

blockedPgStmtTerminateFrequencyMinutes.description: The monitor loop sweeps for blocked PG statements.  This is the frequency that the check will be made.

blockedPgStmtTerminateThresholdMinutes.description:
The monitor loop sweeps for blocked PG statements.  During that sweep, any statements that have been blocked longer
than this will have their connection terminated.
